title: Hortatory Exposition Text
summary: Hortatory exposition: struktur thesis–arguments–recommendation, perbedaan dengan analytical exposition, bahasa ajakan dan saran, serta soal sasaran pembaca, rekomendasi, dan penerapan pada situasi nyata.

blocks.html:
Hortatory exposition tidak hanya meyakinkan pembaca bahwa sesuatu benar, tetapi mengajak pembaca melakukan atau tidak melakukan sesuatu. Contohnya artikel ajakan hemat energi, imbauan kampanye kesehatan, atau editorial tentang kebijakan.

BagianIsi
Thesisisu dan posisi penulis
Argumentsalasan, akibat, dan bukti yang mendukung ajakan
Recommendationsaran atau ajakan kepada pihak tertentu: pembaca, sekolah, pemerintah, perusahaan

Analytical expositionHortatory exposition
Tujuanmeyakinkan bahwa suatu pendapat benar atau pentingmengajak melakukan atau tidak melakukan sesuatu
Penutupreiteration (penegasan tesis)recommendation (saran/ajakan)
Bahasa khasit is clear that, thereforeshould, must, let's, we need to, kalimat perintah

blocks.title: Ciri kebahasaan
blocks.html:
• Modalitas: should, must, need to, ought to.
  • Kalimat perintah dan ajakan: Never share your OTP. Let's start today.
  • Kata ganti inklusif: we, us, our untuk membangun rasa kebersamaan.
  • Bahasa emotif: serious, alarming, it is time.

blocks.question: Which sentence is a typical recommendation in a hortatory exposition?

options.A: Plastic waste is increasing every year.
options.B: Many rivers are polluted by plastic.
options.C: Shops should charge customers for plastic bags.
options.D: Plastic was invented in the early 1900s.

blocks.explanation: Kalimat C memberi saran dengan should kepada pihak tertentu (toko). Kalimat lain berupa fakta atau argumen.

blocks.html:
Turn Off, Unplug, Save

[Thesis] Many of us leave chargers plugged in, televisions on standby, and fans running in empty rooms without a second thought. These small habits waste a surprising amount of electricity, and it is time we changed them.

[Argument 1] Devices on standby continue to draw power. Studies in several countries have estimated that standby power can account for around five to ten percent of a household's electricity use. That is money paid for electricity that does nothing useful.

[Argument 2] Wasted electricity also has an environmental cost. Much of our electricity is still generated by burning fossil fuels, so every unnecessary kilowatt-hour adds to air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.

[Argument 3] Saving energy, moreover, is one of the few environmental actions that also saves money immediately. Families who change their habits can see the difference on their next electricity bill.

[Recommendation] So let's take simple steps. Unplug chargers when they are not in use, switch devices off instead of leaving them on standby, and turn off lights and fans when you leave a room. Schools should appoint student "energy monitors" to check classrooms at the end of each day. Small actions, repeated by millions of people, can make a big difference.

blocks.title: Soal jenis teks
blocks.question: Why is this text a hortatory exposition and not an analytical exposition?
steps: Paragraf terakhir berisi ajakan (let's), kalimat perintah, dan saran untuk sekolah (should).
Penutupnya rekomendasi, bukan sekadar penegasan tesis.
blocks.answer: It ends with recommendations that urge readers to act

blocks.title: Soal sasaran pembaca
blocks.question: Who are the recommendations directed at?
steps: Kalimat perintah ditujukan kepada pembaca umum (keluarga).
Ada juga saran khusus untuk sekolah.

blocks.question: Why does the writer mention that saving energy saves money immediately?

options.A: To show that electricity is too cheap
options.B: To give readers a personal, practical reason to act
options.D: To explain how electricity is produced

blocks.explanation: Manfaat langsung bagi dompet keluarga membuat pembaca lebih termotivasi untuk mengikuti ajakan.

lessons.title: Latihan interaktif: struktur dan jenis eksposisi

blocks.title: Struktur hortatory dan analytical vs hortatory
blocks.caption: Tentukan bagian struktur hortatory exposition, lalu bedakan teks analytical dan hortatory dari kalimat penutupnya.

blocks.title: Strategi mengerjakan
blocks.html:
• Paragraf terakhir hortatory biasanya menjawab soal What does the writer want readers to do?
  • Untuk soal klasifikasi tindakan (recommended / not recommended), cocokkan setiap tindakan dengan kalimat perintah atau larangan di teks.
  • Soal Why is X a problem? sering dijawab dengan rantai sebab-akibat (malu → tidak melapor → pelaku terus beraksi).
  • Perhatikan kepada siapa setiap saran ditujukan: individu, sekolah, perusahaan, atau pemerintah.

blocks.title: Jebakan yang sering muncul
blocks.html:
• Memilih saran yang terdengar baik tetapi tidak disebut di teks.
  • Menganggap angka perkiraan (rentang) sebagai angka pasti.
  • Tertukar rekomendasi untuk satu pihak dengan pihak lain.
Setelah memahami materi dan contoh di atas, kerjakan kuis bab ini. Teks Tingkat Lanjut lebih panjang dan argumentatif, jadi bacalah dengan teliti dan pelajari pembahasan setiap soal yang salah.
